subject: Follow-up: technical deep dive — reschedule & tighter RSVP

Subject: Quick recap + proposed next steps (technical deep dive)

Hi Beth —

Really appreciated the discovery convo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs: predictable sub-200ms p95 for short prompts, private VPC option, and cost forecasts for 10M tokens/month.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 1) <20ms median for embeddings, 2) clear data retention policy, 3) predictable billing model for pilot.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Technical deep dive with our infra engineer to validate throughput and network setup (30–45m)
2) Share a draft commercial outline for the pilot
3) Run a short eval on a representative prompt set once we agree on infra config

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Thu Jun 4, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Jun 4, 15:00–15:45
- Mon Jun 8, 10:00–10:45

Can you pick one and confirm by EOD Wednesday? We’ll hold the date for 24 hours after you reply; otherwise we’ll release the slot to other prospects.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.docx (agenda stub), avt-proposal-draft.pdf (initial commercial outline)

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
